reference.notes:
Tests left failing:
- apps/api/test/hidden-sliced-fixtures/routes.test.ts :: [happy-5] every context builder defaults to the graph deadline, an asked one wins, and a map reader names the graph run :: it loops over the package's `CONTEXT_BUILDERS`, which in this copy still includes `dependency_cruiser` and `deepwiki`, and expects 202 for them. The spec, and `[unhappy-5]` in the same file, require 400, so both can't pass in this copy.
- apps/api/test/analysis.test.ts :: a context builder names itself in its parameters :: expects 202 for `dependency_cruiser` and `deepwiki`, with a 60-minute default for `deepwiki`; the spec requires 400.
- apps/api/test/analysis.test.ts :: Build all queues the whole set once the cap admits its first run :: expects five builders and caps `[3, 8, 8, 8, 8]`; the spec says three builders and `[3, 6, 6]`.
- apps/api/test/analysis.test.ts :: Build all answers built runs as is, with each builder's parameters :: expects `dependency_cruiser` and a 60-minute `deepwiki` in the set; the spec says "Build all" queues only `graphify`, `abstractions` and `data_model`.
- apps/api/test/analysis.test.ts :: Build all skips the map readers when the graph is out of retries :: expects `dependency_cruiser` and `deepwiki` after a failed graph; the spec says only the graph is enqueued.
- apps/api/test/pricing-profiler.test.ts :: a requested profile is scoped, sliced and built from what was measured :: expects `scoping` and a scope run with no reader ids on the first sweep. The spec says the profile waits in `queued` until `abstractions` and `data_model` have finished, and this test's fake store creates them `queued`.
- apps/api/test/pricing-profiler.test.ts :: at the organization's analysis cap a profile waits, and the rest of the sweep enqueues nothing :: expects `scoping` while the readers are still queued; the spec waits in `queued`.
- apps/api/test/pricing-profiler.test.ts :: a scope that fails, or a graph that already did, fails the profile with the run's code :: expects a scope run after one sweep, before the readers have finished, which the spec forbids.
- apps/api/test/pricing-profiler.test.ts :: a snapshot or run that is no longer there fails the profile as unavailable :: its scope-mismatch and pruned-scope cases need a scope run from the first sweep, which the spec forbids while the readers are queued.
- apps/api/test/pricing-profiler.test.ts :: a scope or slice whose recorded output cannot be read fails as invalid :: expects a scope run after one sweep, before the readers have finished, which the spec forbids.
- apps/api/test/pricing-profiler.test.ts :: a slice that fails, or cannot be queued against its graph, fails the profile :: expects a scope run after one sweep, before the readers have finished, which the spec forbids.
- apps/api/test/pricing-profiler.test.ts :: building needs the snapshot, the spec revision and the scope it came from :: expects a scope run after one sweep, before the readers have finished, which the spec forbids.
- apps/api/test/pricing-profiler.test.ts :: one row's failure does not stop the others, and a failed launch is reported :: expects `scoping` while the readers are still queued; the spec waits in `queued`.
- apps/api/test/pricing-profiler.test.ts :: one organization whose rows cannot be read does not stop the others :: expects `scoping` while the readers are still queued; the spec waits in `queued`.
- apps/api/test/pricing-profiler.test.ts :: a re-queued run's old log is removed from the bucket :: counts old-log removals for the graph and scope only. The spec removes the old log of every run the queued step re-queues, readers included, and the scope isn't reached in the first sweep.
- apps/api/test/pricing-profiler.test.ts :: a profile that settles, ready or failed, is handed on once, and its trouble is only reported :: expects a scope run after one sweep, before the readers have finished, which the spec forbids.
